subject: SE demo slot triage - constrained window from Chronicle AI
messages:
From: Sarah Kay <sarah.kay@chronicleai.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Chronicle AI Procurement <procurement@chronicleai.com>, devops@chronicleai.com
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request – narrow window next week

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. Chronicle AI is ready to see a technical walkthrough of Redwood, but we have a constrained availability window next week because our procurement and security folks will be on site. Can we do a 45–60 minute demo focused on:

- Integration / API flow (ingest, auth, VPC options)
- Performance: latency & cost controls for bursty workloads
- Security: data residency, audit logs, SOC2 evidence to review

Possible windows (all PDT):
- Tuesday 2027-05-18: 10:00–11:00 or 16:30–17:30
- Wednesday 2027-05-19: 09:30–10:30 only

Procurement also asked if you can share a short PO template and any SOC2 summary ahead of time. I can pull in our security engineer (David) but he needs the session to be in the slots above.

Thanks — please let me know which slot works and who from your side we should include.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Kay
Head of Platform Operations, Chronicle AI

Attachments: none in this message
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Kay <sarah.kay@chronicleai.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request – narrow window next week

Hi Sarah — great to hear. Thanks for listing the constraints.

We can accommodate a focused 45-minute session that covers the three buckets you called out. Quick notes:
- Aditya (Solutions Engineering) will run the demo and cover integration and performance.
- Ben (Customer Success / onboarding) can cover procurement/PO flow and next steps.
- We should include a short security addendum section and have a SOC2 summary ready before the call.

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue 2027-05-18 16:30–17:15 (preferred)
- Wed 2027-05-19 09:30–10:15 (alternate)

If those work, I’ll send a calendar invite and attach a short agenda + the PO template you requested.

Quick question for David / devops: do you need an IP allowlist window or SSO demo in the same session? If so, we’ll reserve the first 10 minutes for that.

Attaching: SE_Demo_Agenda_v1.pdf (agenda + proposed attendee list)

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: SE_Demo_Agenda_v1.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

Cc: Sarah Kay <sarah.kay@chronicleai.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request – narrow window next week

I can do both proposed slots — prefer Tue 16:30 if that’s what the customer wants.

Couple of technical asks I’ll need before the demo so we can prepare a short live run:
- Expected max sequence length / typical request pattern (burst vs sustained)
- Confirmation if Chronicle will want SSO/SCIM or just API keys for the POC
- Whether you want us to demonstrate a private/VPC deployment or hosted API flow

If David wants to show IP allowlist or firewall rules, we can reserve 10 minutes at the start as Mina suggested.

– Aditya
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks, Mina — Tue 16:30–17:15 (PDT) works for us. Two notes from procurement/security:

1) Can you add a security engineer from Redwood for the SOC2 / audit log discussion? If not, Aditya’s fine as long as we get the SOC2 summary ahead of time.
2) Procurement requested a PO template — I’ve attached a procurement checklist on our side.

Also: would it be possible to start the call at 16:45 instead? We have a conflicting internal review that may run long; moving by 15 minutes would help. Would that still fit a 45-minute run-through?
